Step 2: Cut lemon, reserving two slices for garnish.
Step 3: Juice the rest of the lemon.
Step 4: Mix together the lemon juice, strawberries, apple juice, and soda water.

cocktails.name: Holloween Punch
cocktails.description: This punch is perfect for Halloween parties with its unusual appearance and pleasant taste.
steps: Take grape juice and a carbonated drink (like club soda, ginger ale, lemon-lime soda).
Mix them in a punch bowl.
Take orange sherbet and lime sherbet.
Scoop out some sherbet and float them in the punch.
Let the sherbet melt a little to create a film on top of the punch.
Make sure the sherbet scoops remain on the surface, creating 'bubbles' in the punch.

steps: Melt the chocolate, butter, and vanilla in a double boiler.
Once smooth, stir in the cream.
Mix until you achieve a smooth texture.
Garnish with mini marshmallows on top.

cocktails.name: Iced Coffee
cocktails.description: Iced Coffee is a refreshing drink perfect for hot days. It combines strong coffee, sugar, and milk to create a creamy texture.
cocktails.garnish: Can be garnished with whipped cream or chocolate shavings.
steps: Step 1: In a small bowl, mix hot water and instant coffee until fully dissolved.
Step 2: Add sugar and stir until completely dissolved.
Step 3: Pour in cold milk and shake well.
Step 4: Use a blender or milkshake maker to create foam.
Step 5: Pour the drink into a coffee mug and serve with ice.

cocktails.name: Ipamena
cocktails.description: Ipamena is a refreshing cocktail with a vibrant flavor of passion fruit and lime, perfect for summer parties.
cocktails.ice: Fill the glass with ice cubes.
cocktails.garnish: Garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime.
steps: Cut half a lime into pieces and place in a shaker.
Add brown sugar and crush the lime with the sugar.
Measure the passion fruit juice and add it to the shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice cubes.
Close the shaker and shake vigorously.
Strain the liquid into a glass.
Stir with a teaspoon and garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime.

steps: Combine yogurt and cold water in a blender.
Add ground roasted cumin, salt, and dried mint.
Blend in the blender for 3 seconds.
Check the consistency and add more water if needed.

steps: Put mango, yogurt, sugar, and ice into a blender.
Pour the drink into a highball glass with crushed ice.
Garnish with mango slices or mint if desired.

Blend until the yogurt becomes more liquid.
Add lemon or lime juice optionally for a slight tartness.
Pour into a highball glass and serve chilled.

Let soak in the water for 15 minutes.
Add the sugar and the lemon juice.

steps: In a large glass, squeeze the lime juice.
Fill the glass with cold seltzer water.
Add lime peels to the glass.
Drink and repeat until limes or soda run out.

cocktails.name: Masala Chai
cocktails.description: Masala Chai is a fragrant Indian beverage made with tea, spices, and milk.
steps: Step 1: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Step 2: Add all the ingredients and boil again for about 15 seconds.
Step 3: Let stand for a minute.
Step 4: Warm milk in a pot.
Step 6: Add milk and sugar to taste.

cocktails.name: Melya
cocktails.description: Melya is a delightful coffee with a chocolate flavor, combining espresso, honey, and cocoa.
steps: In a coffee mug, place 1 teaspoon of unsweetened powdered cocoa.
Then cover a teaspoon with honey and drizzle it into the cup.
Stir while the coffee brews, this is the fun part.
The cocoa seems to coat the honey without mixing, creating a dusty, sticky mass.
Then all at once, presto! It looks like dark chocolate sauce.
Pour hot espresso over the honey, stirring to dissolve.

cocktails.name: Mint Limeade (Non-alcoholic)
cocktails.description: A refreshing non-alcoholic cocktail with mint and lime.
steps: Lightly MUDDLE (just to bruise) mint in base of shaker.
Add next three ingredients, SHAKE with ice and fine strain into ice-filled glass.

cocktails.name: Nuked Hot Chocolate
cocktails.description: Nuked Hot Chocolate is a cozy and sweet drink, perfect for cold days.
cocktails.garnish: Can be garnished with whipped cream or chocolate shavings.
steps: In a coffee mug, mix cocoa powder, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add a bit of milk (about 1 oz) and stir.
Nuke the mug for about 30-50 seconds.
Stir until the heated cocoa dissolves.
Fill the mug with the remaining milk.
Nuke for 1-2 minutes, depending on wattage and preferences.

cocktails.name: Orange Scented Hot Chocolate
cocktails.description: A creamy and aromatic hot chocolate with hints of orange, perfect for cold days.
steps: Step 1: Combine all ingredients in a heavy medium saucepan.
Step 2: Stir over low heat until chocolate melts.
Step 3: Increase heat and bring just to a boil, stirring often.
Step 4: Remove from heat and whisk until frothy.
Step 5: Return to heat and bring to boil again.
Step 6: Remove from heat, whisk until frothy.
Step 7: Repeat heating and whisking once again.
